method.source: Evaluated .blend meshes and transforms; JSON only supplies room/aperture intent
method.projection: Individual mesh convex hulls, clipped to body height; conservative for concave or disconnected meshes
method.exclusions: Ground rugs/runners/curtains, ceilings, wall artwork and objects wholly below .12m or above 1.75m are not walking obstacles
method.limitations: Conservative geometric audit; does not certify regulations, accessibility, door swing animation or every furniture operation
